purpose: 39 character-specific social-feed images, three per persona

assets.name: Victoria
assets.caption: The gallery after closing. Just me, this canvas, and a conversation I’m not quite finished having.
assets.scene: her own candid phone photograph of an intimate contemporary gallery just after closing, warm wall lamps, one large abstract canvas with earthy pigments, a sculptural bench and polished concrete floor

assets.name: Victoria
assets.caption: Bought flowers with no occasion in mind. That should count as an occasion.

assets.name: Victoria
